name: Shoot Fireball
summary:
[Game Overview]
Step into mixed reality and unleash powerful magic from your hands.
Shoot fireballs from your right hand and ice blasts from your left, directly into your real-world environment.

Enjoy dynamic visual effects and satisfying impacts when your magic hits walls around you.

[Features]
- Hand tracking magic system (no controllers needed)
- Fire and ice spells with immersive effects
- Real-world interaction using MR
- Responsive sound and impact effects

[Controls]
- Hand gestures only
